title: House Robber II (Circular)
statement: You are a professional robber planning to rob houses along a street. All houses at this place are arranged in a circle. That means the first house is the neighbor of the last one. Each house has a certain amount of money stashed. Adjacent houses have security systems connected. Return the maximum amount of money you can rob tonight without alerting the police.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.

examples.explanation: Can't take first and last (adjacent in circle). Max is 3.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
